question.text: Let <math><mi>α</mi></math> and <math><mi>β</mi></math> be two numbers where <math><mi>α</mi><mo><</mo><mi>β</mi></math><math> <mo>.</mo> </math> The geometric mean of these numbers exceeds the smaller number <math><mi>α</mi></math> by <math> <mrow> <mn>12</mn> </mrow> </math> and the arithmetic mean of the same numbers is smaller by <math> <mrow> <mn>24</mn> </mrow> </math> than the larger number <math><mi>β</mi></math><math><mo>,</mo> </math> then the value of <math><mo>|</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>α</mi><mo>|</mo></math> is

solution.text:
Given, α and β be two number where α<β .

∵   The geometric mean of these numbers exceeds the smaller number α by 12 .

i.e. αβ=α+12 .....(i)

And the arithmetic mean of the same numbers is smaller by 24 than the number β .

i.e. α+β2=β-24 ......(ii)

By solving Equations. (i) and (ii), we get

α=6, β=54

∴        β-α=54-6=48
